exchanges: okay so st johns is so windy that my umbrella died on the first day, literally inside out and in the trash within an hour of landing
The wind there is famous for that. A good hood might serve you better than an umbrella.
yeah lesson learned, i went downtown and bought a proper parka today because everyone told me the winter here is no joke and i believe them now
Sounds like a smart buy before the real cold sets in.
my roommate liam laughed at me the whole time, hes from out west and thinks this is nothing
He has probably seen worse winters.
liam also has an Oilers flag over his bed which is a choice, he wont shut up about mcdavid
Hockey fans do like to decorate.
ha yeah. ok so ive figured out the Metrobus finally, i take it to campus every morning since res is kind of far from my classes
Good, having the route figured out makes mornings easier.
the drivers are so nice here, one waited for me while i ran for it
People there have a reputation for being friendly.
my aunt esi texted me a picture of her cat Pepper wearing a tiny sweater, she says its for the cold even though she lives in accra
That is adorable, even if the cat does not need it.
and then my great aunt abena got jealous and sent a pic of her parrot Juju sitting on her shoulder, the family group chat is just pets now
That sounds like a fun group chat.
it really is, i love them
It is nice to stay connected that way.
my lab partner joaquin is filipino and he was saying hes fluent in Tagalog and teaches his little cousins on weekends
That is a great skill to pass on.
he offered to teach me some words lol
That would be a fun way to learn.
i found the best cafe, Rocket, down near the harbour and i think its my new favourite place to study
A good study spot is worth a lot.
their bread is so good
Fresh bread is hard to resist.
my little brother kojo called, he said mom made jollof and he ate three plates, its his favourite thing in the world
Sounds like he is missing you less than the food.
rude lol. i miss moms cooking
Home cooking is one of the hardest things to leave behind.
im flying home at Thanksgiving tho so i get to eat it then
Something to look forward to.
correction on joaquin btw, he told me its actually Cebuano he speaks not tagalog, he says everyone assumes
Good to know, that is an easy mix-up.
yeah i felt bad
He probably hears it a lot and did not mind.
probably. ok im gonna try to do some reading
Good luck, a quiet hour can get a lot done.
cant focus at all
Maybe a short walk would help.
my friend saoirse from res dragged me to a spin class, she goes every Wednesday and now she wants me to come weekly
That is a good way to build a routine.
my legs are jelly
That is normal after a first class.
wait whats the name of my great aunts parrot again

earlier_question.right_reply: Your great-aunt Abena's parrot is called Juju.
earlier_question.wrong_reply: Your great-aunt Abena's parrot is called Pepper.
